qa.question: Does the Digimon that has this card as it's digivolution card count itself for this card's inherited effect?
qa.answer: Yes, it does.

qa.question: If I have 4 Digimon, does a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards get +2000 DP with this card's inherited effect?
qa.answer: No, it doesn't. If you have 2 or more Digimon, this effect can only get that Digimon +1000 DP.

qa.question: What does this card's "Players can't reduce play costs" effect do, exactly?
qa.answer: It negates effects that read, “reduce the play cost by X.” When you or your opponent activates an effect like that, it won't reduce the play cost that needs to be paid. The full play cost of the card needs to be paid.

qa.question: Can "Play this card without paying the cost" effects be activated if this Digimon is in play?
qa.answer: Yes, "Play this card without paying the cost" effects are not effects that reduce the play cost, so they can activate.

qa.question: Can the play cost of a Digimon with the [Royal Knight] trait be reduced due to the [Your Turn] effect of my opponent's [BT13-007 King Drasil_7D6] if this Digimon is in play?
qa.answer: No, they can't be reduced. This card's effect does not target Digimon, so even if your opponent's [BT13-007 King Drasil_7D6] is in the breeding area, its effect to reduce play costs can't be activated.

qa.question: When I have this Digimon, can my opponent no longer use [BT14-046 Togemon]'s [Your Turn] effect or inherited effect to reduce the play cost of green Tamer cards?
qa.answer:
That's correct. Such effects can no longer reduce play costs.
This card's effect also prevents play cost-reducing effects from activating when Tamer cards are played.

qa.question: If I activate this card's [Main] effect while a Digimon such as ST12-03 [Solarmon] with a "players can't reduce play costs" effect is in the battle area, can I play 1 card with [Sistermon] or [Gankoomon] in its name?
qa.answer: You can activate the effect and play such a card, but its play cost won't be reduced.

qa.question: If a Digimon with the effect "Players can't reduce play costs," such as [ST12-03 Solarmon], is in the battle area, can I activate this card's [Main] effect and play a specified card?
qa.answer: You can activate it and play the card, but the cost will not be reduced.

qa.question: If a Digimon with the effect "Players can't reduce play costs," such as [ST12-03 Solarmon], is in the battle area, can I activate this card's [Main] effect and play one specified card?
qa.answer: You can activate it and play the card, but the cost will not be reduced.

qa.question: If I activate this card's [Main] effect while a Digimon such as ST12-03 [Solarmon] with a "players can't reduce play costs" effect is in the battle area, can I activate this card's [Main] effect and play 1 of the specified cards?
qa.answer: You can activate the effect and play such a card, but its cost won't be reduced.

qa.question: If I activate this card's [Main] effect while a Digimon such as ST12-03 [Solarmon] with a "players can't reduce play costs" effect is in the battle area, can I activate this card's [Main] effect and play 1 of the specified cards?
qa.answer: You can activate the effect and play such a card, but its play cost won't be reduced.

qa.question: If I activate this card's [Main] effect while a Digimon such as ST12-03 [Solarmon] with a "players can't reduce play costs" effect is in the battle area, can I activate this card's [Your Turn] effect and play 1 of the specified cards?
qa.answer: You can activate the effect and play such a card, but its play cost won't be reduced.

qa.question: If I play 2 or more Digimon with [Sistermon] in their names at the same time, do I gain 1 memory for each Digimon played?
qa.answer: No. Even if 2 or more Digimon with [Sistermon] in their names are played at the same time, you only gain 1 memory by this card’s effect.

qa.question: When this Digimon’s [When Attacking] effect plays 1 Digimon card with [Sistermon] in its name, do I get the benefits of this Digimon's [Your Turn] effect for the same attack?
qa.answer: Yes, the effect activates during that attack.

qa.question: Can I choose to not activate this card's [On Play] effect?
qa.answer: Yes, the effect reads "By trashing 1 card in your hand," so you may also choose to not trash a card in your hand. In such cases, you don't <Draw 2>.

qa.question: What happens to "*Also treat as if name is [Sistermon Noir] and traits include [Virus]" on this card when it is in my hand or breeding area?
qa.answer: "*Also treat as if name is [Sistermon Noir] and traits include [Virus]" is a special rule for this card, not an effect. Therefore, this text also applies when the card is in your hand, breeding area, or any other area.

qa.question: Does this card have the 4 traits, [Champion], [Puppet], [Virus] and [Data]?
qa.answer: This card is treated as having both the [Virus] and [Data] traits, but only 1 at a time, so it is treated as having 3 traits in total, 1 of them together with the [Champion] and [Puppet] traits.

qa.question: I have BT10-085 [Sistermon Ciel]. Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect to play a BT6-084 [Sistermon Ciel] or ST12-13 [Sistermon Ciel] that's also treated as [Sistermon Noir]?
qa.answer:
No, it can't be played.
"With the same names" also refers to a card with even just 1 of the same name as any of your Digimon.
This effect can't play cards with the same name as [Sistermon Ciel].

qa.question: Can I choose different Digimon for this card's effect to get +2000 DP and gain <Piercing>?
qa.answer: Yes, you can choose different Digimon for each of the effects. You can choose the same Digimon or different ones.

qa.question: If none of the cards revealed from the deck with this card's effect include [Huckmon] or [Sistermon] in their names or the [Royal Knight] trait among them, is this card still placed in the Battle Area?
qa.answer: Yes, regardless of the cards revealed, after trashing the rest of the cards revealed, place this card in your Battle Area.

qa.question: After activating this card's <Delay>, can I still reduce the digivolution cost if one of my Digimon would digivolve due to an effect?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

comprehensive-0223.title: <Blocker>
comprehensive-0223.text:
16-5. <Blocker>
16-5-1. <Blocker> is a keyword effect that applies a rule that allows a Digimon with that effect to block. (For details, refer to 12 "Blocking")
16-5-2. <Blocker> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")
16-5-3. Even if 1 Digimon has multiple instances of <Blocker>, the number of blocks that can be performed during the block timing is only 1.

comprehensive-0225.title: <Piercing>
comprehensive-0225.text:
16-7. <Piercing>
16-7-1. <Piercing> is a keyword effect that reads "When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle while attacking, it checks security before the attack ends." (For details, refer to 13 "Security Checks")
16-7-2. <Piercing> is a trigger-type effect that triggers and activates when a Digimon with this effect battles an opponent's Digimon and the opponent's Digimon is deleted in battle. (For details, refer to 15-8-3 "Trigger- Type Effects")
16-7-3. The security check from using <Piercing> is mandatory.
16-7-4. <Piercing> is pending processing that is processed immediately before the transition to the end of attack timing. Therefore, it will trigger simultaneously with effects triggered by the battle, but it is processed before the end of the attack. (Example: If a Digimon with <Piercing> attacks and deletes a Digimon with an [On Deletion] effect in the battle, first the [On Deletion] effect is resolved, then <Piercing> is processed.)
16-7-5. Only 1 security check can be performed during a single attack, even if <Piercing> activates multiple times. However, if the number of cards that can be checked by the attacking Digimon is modified, that number of cards will be checked in a single security check.
16-7-6. If there are no Digimon to perform a security check at the point when <Piercing> is processed, a security check won't be possible.

comprehensive-0226.title: <Draw>
comprehensive-0226.text:
16-8. <Draw>
16-8-1. <Draw> is a keyword effect where a player draws the cards from their deck according to the number specified in the effect. This is shown on cards using text such as <Draw 1>.
16-8-2. <Draw> effects execute processing.
16-8-3. A draw from <Draw> is mandatory.

comprehensive-0229.title: <Reboot>
comprehensive-0229.text:
16-11. <Reboot>
16-11-1. <Reboot> is a keyword effect where a Digimon with this effect is unsuspended during the opponent's unsuspend phase.
16-11-2. <Reboot> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")
16-11-3. Even if 1 Digimon has multiple instances of <Reboot>, it is only unsuspended once during the opponent's unsuspend phase.
16-11-4. The unsuspending from <Reboot> is mandatory.
16-11-5. The unsuspending from <Reboot> is performed at the same time as the unsuspending of the turn player's Digimon. The unsuspends aren't performed in any particular order.

comprehensive-0230.title: <De-Digivolve>
comprehensive-0230.text:
16-12. <De-Digivolve>
16-12-1. <De-Digivolve> is a keyword effect where the player declares a number from 1 up to the number specified in the effect, then the declared number of cards are trashed from the chosen stack(s) of cards starting with the top card. This is shown on cards using text such as <De- Digivolve 1>.
16-12-2. <De-Digivolve> effects execute processing.
16-12-3. The trashing from <De-Digivolve> is mandatory. Once activated, a player can't choose to trash 0 cards.
16-12-4. <De-Digivolve> can't trash cards from level 3 cards or lower.
16-12-5. If multiple cards are trashed using 1 instance of <De- Digivolve>, all of the cards are considered to be trashed at the same time, but the procedure for trashing them is 1 card from the stack at a time.
16-12-6. When using <De-Digivolve> to trash multiple cards, even if the category of the top card changes while the trashing is still being performed, the trashing will continue until the declared number is trashed.
16-12-7. When separate instances of <De-Digivolve> are executed multiple times in a single effect, the processing is performed separately for each instance.
16-12-8. When separate instances of <De-Digivolve> are executed multiple times in a single effect, the state of the chosen card is confirmed after each single process for <De-Digivolve> ends. If an effect will be activated as a result of the confirmed state, it is then activated. (Example: When 3 instances of <De-Digivolve 1> are executed in a single effect, if the chosen card becomes an "unaffected by effects" card as a result of the 1st instance of <De-Digivolve 1>, that card is unaffected by the following instances of <De-Digivolve 1>.

comprehensive-0234.title: <Blitz>
comprehensive-0234.text:
16-16. <Blitz>
16-16-1. <Blitz> is a keyword effect where a Digimon with this effect can attack if your opponent has 1 or more memory.
16-16-2. <Blitz> effects execute processing.
16-16-3. <Blitz> has a processing condition that requires the memory to be at 1 or more on your opponent's side. "This Digimon may attack" is optional processing.
16-16-4. After using <Blitz> to make an attack declaration, the attack will proceed even if the memory moves to 0 or more.38
16-16-5. An attack can't be made using <Blitz> if the memory is at 0 or more upon activating <Blitz>.

comprehensive-0235.title: <Delay>
comprehensive-0235.text:
16-17. <Delay>
16-17-1. <Delay> is a keyword effect. While a card with this effect is in the battle area, by trashing that card, the effect specified in <Delay> will activate.
16-17-2. The processing from <Delay> is optional. (For details, refer to 15-7 "Optional Processing Conditions")
16-17-3. <Delay> can't be activated the same turn the card with the effect is placed in the battle area.

comprehensive-0236.title: <Decoy>
comprehensive-0236.text:
16-18. <Decoy>
16-18-1. <Decoy> is a keyword effect. When another of your specified Digimon would be deleted by an opponent's effect, by deleting the Digimon with this effect, <Decoy> prevents the Digimon specified by this effect from being deleted. This is shown on cards using text such as <Decoy (Black)>.
16-18-2. <Decoy> is an immediate-type effect that triggers when another of your Digimon specified by this effect would be deleted by an opponent's effect (For details, refer to 15-8-5 "Immediate-Type Effects")
16-18-3. "By deleting this Digimon" in <Decoy> is an optional processing condition. If the content of that condition is executed, the processing for "<Decoy> prevents the Digimon specified by this effect from being deleted" will be mandatory.
